title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal AI…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Drupal AI versions from 0.0.0 to 1.4.11 and from 1.5.0 to 1.5.2 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This flaw allows malicious input to be stored and later executed in users' browsers when viewing affected pages.
